review_locator: PMID:38825010, Polymerizing laminins in development, health, and disease; PMCID:PMC4648024, Laminin-Mediated Interactions in Thymocyte Migration and Development
primary_title: Laminins 411 and 421 differentially promote tumor cell migration via alpha6beta1 integrin and MCAM (CD146)
decision_basis: The reviews identify alpha6beta1 as a receptor for laminin-411 and cite the primary isoform-comparison study showing direct alpha6beta1 binding and alpha6beta1-dependent migration on laminin-411.
limitations_preserved: Preserve laminin-411 isoform and alpha6beta1 heterodimer; cell-adhesion/migration context without purified full-length structural complex, universal integrin signaling, or SCI inference.
